issue.title: test_real_fakey_retry_countdown / running_fallback PNG snapshots fail on every run: 15 s DONE-sentinel timeout in the workspace, a stable 491-pixel golden mismatch in worktrees
issue.description:
Two ACE retry end-to-end PNG snapshot tests fail deterministically on master and are not caused by the sase-11y.7 Services-tab phase:

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py::test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot`
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py::test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot`

Reproduce (2 of 2 runs failed in workspace sase_32 at master 6087c0a8e, 79 s and 102 s):

    just fix-tui-screenshots --check -- -k "test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot or test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot"

Two failure signatures, depending on where the test is run, and I did not establish why:

1. In the sase_32 workspace checkout via `just fix-tui-screenshots --check`: both nodes time out after 15.00 s inside `_reload_finished_agent(page)` waiting for the SVG sentinel `DONE` (`tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_png_snapshot_waits.py:42`).
2. In detached git worktrees under /tmp (`PYTHONPATH=<worktree>:<worktree>/src .venv/bin/python tools/run_pytest visual -k ...`): both nodes render and then fail the golden comparison with the same 491/1520532 changed pixels (0.032291%), identically at 45a7895b6^, at 45a7895b6, and at 6087c0a8e.

Because the 491-pixel drift is byte-identical at all three commits, and they fail in each, no commit in that range explains it; the cause predates the sase-13i.2 tribe-panel work (45a7895b6, 2026-09-19). The original commit that broke them was not bisected. The two signatures suggest the frame content is not the whole story (a path-dependent difference between the workspace checkout and /tmp is one hypothesis), so establish which signature is the real one first.

Related but distinct: sase-x5 and sase-10u track broad Agents-pane golden drift; closed sase-dc stabilized these same two tests under full-suite contention, which is not this failure (these fail run alone). Do not just regenerate the goldens; find what changed in the rendered frame.

Measured while verifying the sase-11y.7 gate repair; the same two nodes also failed in the previous worker's baseline at 244442ee8. The other two nodes in that baseline (`test_agents_collapsed_panel_png_snapshot`, `test_queued_clan_counts_png_snapshot`) were caused by sase-13i.2 (45a7895b6) and are recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE note on epic sase-13i, not here.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed on every run: 2 of 2 in the sase_32 workspace via `just fix-tui-screenshots --check` at 6087c0a8e, and in detached-worktree replays at 45a7895b6^, 45a7895b6 and 6087c0a8e, each of which failed both nodes with a byte-identical 491-pixel diff (0.032291%). A rerun on the same tree never passed, the runs were serial or lightly parallel (not a saturated lane), and the diff size does not vary between runs or commits, so this is a stable rendering difference, not timing.
